description: This Java class 'AccountTransferAssembler' provides methods to assemble and manage account transfer details between savings and loan accounts, including creating transfer transactions and handling different transfer types within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: AccountTransferAssembler
classes.description: Service class responsible for assembling account transfer details and creating transfer transactions between savings and loan accounts.
